sn44.11:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā sabhiyo kaccāno ñātike viharati giñjakāvasathe.
sn44.11:1.2: atha kho vacchagotto paribbājako yenāyasmā sabhiyo kaccāno tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sabhiyena kaccānena saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn44.11:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako āyasmantaṃ sabhiyaṃ kaccānaṃ etadavoca:
sn44.11:1.4: kinnu kho bho kaccāna hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti. avyākataṃ
sn44.11:1.7: kiṃ pana bho kaccāna na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti.
sn44.11:2.1: kinnu kho bho kaccāna hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti. avyākataṃ
sn44.11:2.3: “hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti.
sn44.11:2.4: kiṃ pana bho kaccāna neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti
sn44.11:2.6: “neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti.
sn44.11:3.1: kinnu kho bho kaccāna, hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti iti puṭṭho samāno
sn44.11:3.4: kiṃ pana bho kaccāna, na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti iti puṭṭho samāno
sn44.11:3.7: kinnu kho bho kaccāna, hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti iti puṭṭho samāno
sn44.11:3.9: “hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti vadesi.
sn44.11:3.10: kiṃ pana bho kaccāna, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti iti puṭṭho samāno
sn44.11:3.12: “neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti vadesi.
sn44.11:3.13: ko nu kho bho kaccāna hetu ko paccayo yena taṃ avyākataṃ samaṇena gotamenāti.
sn44.11:3.14: yo ca āvuso, hetu yo ca paccayo paññāpanāya: rūpīti vā arūpīti vā saññīti vā asaññīti vā nevasaññīnāsaññīti vā, so ca hetu so ca paccayo sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ aparisesaṃ nirujjheyya.
sn44.11:3.15: kena naṃ paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya, “rūpīti vā arūpīti vā saññīti vā asaññīti vā nevasaññīti nāsaññīti vā”ti.
sn44.11:3.18: yassapassa āvuso, etamettakena ettakameva tampassa bahu. ko pana vādo eva abhikkanteti.
